#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>
#include <functional>

using namespace std;

class MinCostMaxFlow {
public:
    struct Edge {
        int u, flow, cost, rid;
        Edge(int a, int b, int c, int d) : u(a), flow(b), cost(c), rid(d) {}
    };

    int N, S, T, maxFlow, minCost;
    const int gmax = INT_MAX / 100;
    vector<vector<Edge>> al;
    vector<vector<Edge>> ja;
    vector<int> d;

    MinCostMaxFlow(int n, int source, int sink) : N(n), S(source), T(sink), maxFlow(0), minCost(0) {
        al.resize(N);
        d.resize(N, 0);
    }

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int flow, int cost) {
        int lu = al[u].size(), lv = al[v].size();
        al[u].emplace_back(v, flow, cost, lv);
        al[v].emplace_back(u, 0, -cost, lu);
    }

    void convertToArray() {
        ja.resize(N);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            ja[i] = al[i];
            al[i].clear();
        }
    }

    bool BellmanFord(bool check) {
        fill(d.begin(), d.end(), gmax);
        d[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N - 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                for (const Edge& e : ja[j]) {
                    if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                    if (d[j] + e.cost < d[e.u]) {
                        d[e.u] = d[j] + e.cost;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (check) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                for (const Edge& e : ja[j]) {
                    if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                    if (d[j] + e.cost < d[e.u]) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    vector<int> node, visit, prv, prve, dist;

    bool simple() {
        node.assign(N, 0);
        visit.assign(N, 0);
        prv.assign(N, 0);
        prve.assign(N, 0);
        dist.assign(N, gmax);

        node[0] = S;
        dist[0] = 0;
        int front = 1, back = 0;
        while (front != back) {
            int u = node[back++];
            if (back == N) back = 0;
            visit[u] = 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)ja[u].size(); i++) {
                Edge& e = ja[u][i];
                if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                int cdist = dist[u] + e.cost;
                if (cdist < dist[e.u]) {
                    if (visit[e.u] == 0) {
                        node[front] = e.u;
                        if (++front == N) front = 0;
                    } else if (visit[e.u] == 2) {
                        if (--back == -1) back += N;
                        node[back] = e.u;
                    }
                    visit[e.u] = 1;
                    prve[e.u] = i;
                    prv[e.u] = u;
                    dist[e.u] = cdist;
                }
            }
        }
        return visit[T] != 0;
    }

    bool dijkstra() {
        visit.assign(N, 0);
        prv.assign(N, 0);
        prve.assign(N, 0);
        dist.assign(N, gmax);
        priority_queue<pair<int,int>, vector<pair<int,int>>, greater<pair<int,int>>> pq;

        pq.push({S, 0});
        dist[0] = 0;
        while (!pq.empty()) {
            pair<int,int> p = pq.top(); pq.pop();
            while (dist[p.first] < p.second) {
                if (pq.empty()) break;
                p = pq.top(); pq.pop();
            }
            visit[p.first] = 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)ja[p.first].size(); i++) {
                Edge& e = ja[p.first][i];
                if (e.flow == 0) continue;
                int cdist = p.second + (e.cost + d[p.first] - d[e.u]);
                if (cdist < dist[e.u]) {
                    if (visit[e.u] == 2) return false;
                    pq.push({e.u, cdist});
                    dist[e.u] = cdist;
                    prv[e.u] = p.first;
                    prve[e.u] = i;
                    visit[e.u] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return visit[T] != 0;
    }

    int augment() {
        int p = T;
        int min = gmax;
        while (p != 0) {
            int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
            int val = ja[pp][pe].flow;
            min = min < val ? min : val;
            p = pp;
        }
        p = T;
        while (p != 0) {
            int pp = prv[p], pe = prve[p];
            ja[pp][pe].flow -= min;
            ja[p][ja[pp][pe].rid].flow += min;
            p = pp;
        }
        maxFlow += min;
        return min;
    }

    bool calSimple() {
        while (simple()) {
            minCost += dist[T] * augment();
        }
        return true;
    }

    void updPotential() {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            if (visit[i] != 0) {
                d[i] += dist[i] - dist[S];
            }
        }
    }

    bool calWithPotential() {
        while (dijkstra()) {
            int min = dist[T] + d[T] - d[S];
            minCost += min * augment();
            updPotential();
        }
        return true;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m, k, c, d;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
    int maxl = n + k;
    int T = n * maxl + 1;
    MinCostMaxFlow ans(T + 1, 0, T);

    vector<int> a(k + 1), f(n + 1, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
        f[a[i]]++;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (f[i] == 0) continue;
        ans.addEdge(0, i, f[i], 0);
    }
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
            ans.addEdge(l * n + i, (l + 1) * n + i, k, c);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int a, b;
        cin >> a >> b;
        for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
            for (int p = 1; p <= k; p++) {
                if (a != 1)
                    ans.addEdge(n * l + a, n * (l + 1) + b, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                if (b != 1)
                    ans.addEdge(n * l + b, n * (l + 1) + a, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
            }
        }
    }
    for (int l = 1; l < maxl; l++) {
        ans.addEdge(l * n + 1, T, k, 0);
    }
    ans.convertToArray();
    ans.calWithPotential();
    if (ans.maxFlow != k) {
        cout << "BUG" << endl;
    } else {
        cout << (int)ans.minCost << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
